name: DCCVT Projection of 0-crossing Voronoi vertices
definition: A robust projection strategy to project Voronoi vertices onto the SDF zero-level set by fitting a plane to the projected sites of the enclosing tetrahedron, avoiding the need to explicitly search for the containing tetrahedron or rely on barycentric interpolation which is unreliable when the circumcenter lies far from the tetrahedron.
summary: DCCVT Projection of 0-crossing Voronoi vertices corrects geometric errors by projecting tetrahedron circumcenters onto the SDF zero-level set via a fitted plane, avoiding unreliable interpolation and prohibitive containment searches.
